svg.aria-label: The write path: write() copies data into the page cache and returns at once; the data is only in RAM. fsync forces it through the disk's volatile cache onto stable storage. A crash before fsync loses the write, so databases fsync the write-ahead log before acknowledging a commit.
svg.title: The write path: write() copies data into the page cache and returns at once; the data is only in RAM. fsync forces it through the disk's volatile cache onto stable storage. A crash before fsync loses the write, so databases fsync the write-ahead log before acknowledging a commit.
svg.text: fsync() forces it all the way to stable storage
Databases: append the commit to the WAL, fsync the WAL, then reply "committed".
